newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas to keep capacity on UK route.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas to keep capacity on UK route.

text.p: The International Air Services Commission (IASC) said on Wednesday it was likely to renew Qantas Airways Ltd's capacity allocation on its United Kingdom route.

The IASC said Qantas' existing capacity allocation would expire on June 30 and the renewal, if confirmed, would allow the airline to continue to operate two Boeing 747 services a day between Australia and the United Kingdom.
"The proposed determination differs from Qantas' previous determination in that it accommodates the joint services agreement with British Airways," the IASC said in a statement.

Qantas' agreement with British Airways Plc, which owns a 25 percent stake in the Australian airline, was approved in late 1995 after the companies agreed not to raise prices by more than the Australian inflation rate for three years.
